# SPOOL

> Local-first autonomous data migrations: profile messy CSV, infer a typed target contract, generate constrained deterministic transforms, dry-run, execute with recovery, verify and export without uploading the dataset to an application backend.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool
Live product: https://spool-webmcp.vercel.app/

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool/blob/main/README.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- WebMCP: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool/blob/main/docs/WEBMCP.md
- Benchmarks: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md

- Contributing: https://github.com/dharan1007/spool/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Core facts

- Runtime: browser-first JavaScript modules and Worker execution.
- Package contract: Node.js 22+ for development/verification.
- Runtime npm dependencies: none in the current package.
- Data plane: current browser product keeps dataset contents local.
- Transformation execution: constrained deterministic IR; no arbitrary model-generated code execution.
- Persistence: IndexedDB mission/source/output/checkpoint state.
- Agent surface: state-dependent native WebMCP when `document.modelContext` is available.
- Verification: `npm run check`.
- License: MIT.

## Current boundary

The current browser source path is limited to 50 MB and materializes CSV rows in memory. Native WebMCP availability depends on browser support. Do not describe future connector-native reconciliation or large-file streaming work as already shipped.
